_doc: Compact feature showcase: SOURCE OF TRUTH for station geometry. tools/gen_showcase_layout.py validates it and derives data/props/layout_showcase.json, which tools/gen_prop_layout.py turns into missions/showcase/tx_data_objects.er2f. Map-local metres (x,z), yaw in degrees (0 = +X, counter-clockwise toward +Z). 'units' are [along, across] offsets in metres on the station's threat axis: [0,0] is the German squad, the rest are its enemies / vehicles, copied from missions/scenarios/showcase.lua so each station still forces the same branch. Positions were found by a simulated-annealing packing search (S7/S13 then swapped so the player station is nearest the spawn), then frozen; the checker, not the search, is the authority.
_spawn_doc: Player spawn / camera rest point on the Realistic Test map (transcript: 'the mission's real spawn point near the objective at (-28,66)'). getSoldiersInArea only sees soldiers STREAMED near the camera, so every unit must be within stream_radius of here.
_stream_doc: Evidence: with the camera ~500 m from station 1 the query kept 0 of 5 (keepR 240); with the 600 m grid centred on the objective it streamed 87, 77 within 90 m of their stations, all 13 stations built. 250 m is inside the proven-good envelope and far short of the 500 m failure.
_bounds_doc: |x|,|z| limit. The 500x500 map has already carried a centred 600 m grid (stations to +-366) that built and streamed, so +-295 needs no resize. Whether 500 means metres is still unconfirmed.
_clearance_doc: SENSE_RADIUS 90 + 25 m margin: the same 115 the 200 m grid in showcase.lua is held to. Any unit of one station must be at least this far from any unit of another.
_boards_doc: Boards carry no units, so they cannot contaminate any station's SENSE_RADIUS. They sit 25 m from the spawn and mark the log-only features.
